capacity.realized_capacity_note: The 3.23 req/s model capacity assumes decode batches run full (64 rows). The measured loop cannot sustain that: padded-cache rebuild cost scales with concurrency x context (and needs ~2x the KV when the padded batch is transient), so the first overloaded cell hit CUDA OOM at max_running=96 and the realized equilibrium was ~1.5-1.6 req/s. The frozen ladder is unchanged; two lower control points were added after measuring this, before any policy run completed.

cells.notes: The largest SLO effect of the study is here (static_large 0.520 -> phase_hybrid 0.693), and it rests on a single run per configuration. Two interleaved repetitions of the same cell give (a) the run-to-run spread this machine produces on its own -- including how often a host stall lands in a run -- and (b) 300 paired requests instead of 150, which tightens the exact McNemar test. Everything else is identical to the main-matrix cell: same trace, same limit, same caps.

The burst window (48% of GPU seconds are prefill) at low load, where the ITL gate is the binding constraint. Tests whether the unloaded-cell result transfers to a different arrival pattern and a different length mix.
